## SK Hynix announces $29B buyback; ADRs spike ~6% pre-market, lifting chip sector sentiment

A $29B capital return from the world's leading HBM supplier signals management confidence in the memory upcycle's durability; the pre-market sector lift is a positive read-through for semiconductor holdings broadly, and the buyback resets the capital-return narrative for a stock that had been under pressure.

- SK Hynix announces a $29B share buyback program.
- SKHY ADRs spiked approximately 6% in pre-market trading on the news.
- Headline characterizes it as a record capital return following a steep prior drawdown.
- Coverage frames the buyback as 'refueling chip trade optimism' — positive sentiment spillover to the broader semiconductor sector.
- High confidence classification; material capital allocation and sentiment signal.
